# Security policy

## Reporting a problem

Please don't open a public issue. Use **[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/ThirtyFile/ThirtyFTP/security/advisories/new)** instead, so the problem can be fixed before it is public.

Include what you sent to the server, what happened, the version of the crate, and the settings you use (`require_tls`, `active_mode`, the backend).

## Supported versions

Fixes are released for the newest version only.
